title: Face processing MEEG dataset with HED annotation
description: This dataset is the MEEG (structural MRI, MEG and simultaneous EEG) portion of the multi-subject, multi-modal face processing dataset originally released as ds000117. Eighteen participants viewed photographs of famous, unfamiliar and scrambled faces and made symmetry judgments with key presses. Events were augmented and reorganized and annotated with Hierarchical Event Descriptors (HED), and the EEG data were converted to BioSemi Data Format (BDF).
methods_description: Eighteen participants completed two sessions three months apart, one with fMRI and one with simultaneous MEG and EEG. In the MEEG session they responded to famous, unfamiliar and scrambled faces by pressing one of two keys to judge facial symmetry. Each face was presented twice, with the repeat either immediate or delayed by 5-15 presentations. EEG channels were extracted from the MEG/EEG fif files, fiducials were added, events were extracted and corrected for a 34 ms latency shift, and HED annotations were added. The recordings were then converted from EEGLAB format to BDF. MEG data remain in Elekta Neuromag fif format, and structural MRI was retained to support source localization.
